messages.subject: Graduate Research Associate in Quantitative Ecology at Patuxent Wildlife Research Center: Capture-recapture analysis of black-duck banding and recapture data
parts:
hi all,
 We're looking to hire a part-time (abt 20 hrs per week) graduate student assistant to work up to 12 months on a project which involves developing CJS-type models ("Brownie models") for waterfowl band recover data.  This is a really unique data set (see attached description) and a great opportunity for a motivated and ambitious student in quantitative ecology. There are a couple of clear papers to be written as part of this project that will have impact. The data set is clean and tidy.

 The position would involve a stay here at PWRC for a few weeks but could otherwise be done at your home institution during the academic year.

 You need to be extremely proficient with R, have experience with BUGS, and have experience or at least knowledge of CJS/Brownie models. Interest in waterfowl population biology and management is a plus.

more details attached.

 Do not respond to this email address!

regards
andy
